svg.title: Plate PL-02 — The one loop: VFE to understand, EFE to choose
svg.desc: An engraved-style plate after encyclopedia chapter NA-02. A five-step ring — 1 PERCEIVE, 2 PREDICT, 3 CHOOSE, 4 ACT, 5 OBSERVE AND UPDATE — with the variational free energy F placed at PERCEIVE, the expected free energy G placed at CHOOSE, and the softmax policy selection P(pi) = sigma(-gamma G(pi)) placed at a selection gate on the arc between CHOOSE and ACT. G is marked framing vocabulary, not a scheduler. Every identity is MODELED; gamma is NOT-MEASURED. No magnitude is depicted and nothing is drawn to scale.
svg.text: VFE to understand · EFE to choose
AFTER NA-02 — ACTIVE INFERENCE AS THE METHOD · A METHOD, NOT A RESULT
AT 1 · PERCEIVE — MINIMIZE VARIATIONAL FREE ENERGY (VFE)
F ≥ − ln p(o) · bound gap = DKL[ q(s) ‖ p(s|o) ] , zero iff q(s) = p(s|o)
Minimizing F selects the SIMPLEST SUFFICIENT explanation — it is not maximizing fit.
F and the bound in NATS (natural log) · 1 nat = log2 e = 1.442695… bits · NA02-01 · NA02-02 · NA02-03 — MODELED
The falsifier goes in before the action.
Surprise cannot be computed against a
Skip 2, and step 5 has nothing to update:
the loop degenerates into narration — a
model that only ever confirms itself.
no quantity · no units · nothing to plot
The receipt is o — what actually
do not explain the surprise away.
AT 3 · CHOOSE — MINIMIZE EXPECTED FREE ENERGY (EFE)
Exact under the convention q(o,s|π) = p(o|s) q(s|π). The epistemic
form further treats q(s|o,π) as standing in for p(s|o) — where q is a
poor posterior, the info-gain reading is itself approximate.
Nothing computes G and schedules from it.
Prose implying UNI runs EFE is drift, and is a defect.
UNI-side disposition: NEGATIVE / drift — a UNI LEDGER
state, not a NATURA evidence class. The two vocabularies
are sovereign and are never merged. UNI’s ledger, not this
plate, is the authority on UNI build status.
AT THE SELECTION GATE · BETWEEN 3 AND 4
γ → 0 : uniform (indifferent) over π γ → ∞ : deterministic argmin G
γ carries units of INVERSE NATS (nats−1): the softmax argument must be
dimensionless and G is in nats — a detail routinely dropped. P(π) is
dimensionless. γ is a free parameter with NO UNIVERSAL VALUE, γ > 0,
fit per model or subject — NOT-MEASURED [NA02-05, NA02-06].
Friston et al. (2017): the fuller process-theory form also carries a
past-evidence term alongside γ·G, and γ is itself inferred, not fixed.
observations — what actually arrived at the sensor; the receipt
hidden states — what you cannot see directly and must infer
approximate posterior — your honest, improvable belief; what you optimize
generative model — how states cause observations and how states evolve
likelihood — the A mapping in a discrete POMDP
true posterior — generally intractable; what q approximates
preferences — a prior over PREFERRED observations, p(o|C); the goal, as a distribution
precision — inverse-temperature over policies; units nats−1; γ > 0; NOT-MEASURED [NA02-05]
variational free energy — scores beliefs; upper-bounds surprisal; NATS
expected free energy — scores policies; NATS; on this plate: framing vocabulary, not a scheduler
Kullback–Leibler divergence — non-negative; zero iff the two distributions are equal; NATS
softmax — normalizes −γ·G into a distribution over policies; output dimensionless
hatched ring = this step carries a scalar quantity (F at 1, G at 3). The hatch denotes a CATEGORY, never a magnitude.
numbered tag = the step’s ordinal in the five-step loop of NA-02. Arrows carry sequence only, never a time-scale.
Evidence classes on this plate, NATURA vocabulary [NA-00]: MODELED — every identity here; the model’s assumptions ARE the fence. · NOT-MEASURED — γ, and any organism computing F or G.
After encyclopedia/wing-NATURA/NA-02-the-one-loop.md. Ledger rows NA02-01 … NA02-06 and NA02-10, encyclopedia/NATURE-LEDGER.md.
The loop of NA-02, drawn once: 1 PERCEIVE, 2 PREDICT, 3 CHOOSE, 4 ACT, 5 OBSERVE & UPDATE, and back to 1. The ring is a
sequence, not a clock — the arrows carry no time-scale, and no step is drawn larger or nearer because it matters more.
Two steps carry a scalar, and only two: 1 and 3, marked by the hatched ring. F scores beliefs about what IS. G scores
policies — whose observations have not happened, which is exactly why F cannot score an action. Both are in nats. Per
NA-02, conflating the two is the most common error in applying this framework.
Step 2 carries no formula and is not optional: the falsifier goes in before the action, because surprise cannot be
computed against a prediction that was never made. Skip it, and step 5 has nothing to update.
Why one number must hold both terms. Goal-only (drop the epistemic term) charges toward C through states it cannot
identify. Explore-only (drop the pragmatic term) resolves uncertainty forever and arrives nowhere. Scored apart, the
trade-off weight must be hand-tuned — which is the judgement the construction exists to make principled. It is an
argument about bookkeeping discipline, not a claim that any organism computes G.
Sources. Buckley et al. (2017) J. Math. Psych. 81:55–79 · Da Costa et al. (2020) J. Math. Psych. 99:102447 · Friston et al.
(2017) Neural Computation 29(1):1–49, DOI 10.1162/NECO_a_00912 · Parr, Pezzulo & Friston (2022) Active Inference,
MIT Press, DOI 10.7551/mitpress/12441.001.0001. Douady & Couder’s unrelated G is NOT this G — see NA-02.
WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM
A method, not a result. Reading this plate raises no rung and settles no question. It is not evidence that anything is
intelligent, aware, self-aware, or conscious. A system that minimizes F is a system that minimizes F.
Not that any biological system computes F or G explicitly — NOT-MEASURED [NA02-10]. Falsifier: a pre-registered
neural recording decoding a per-policy G in nats.
Not that a low F is a correctness certificate. F upper-bounds surprisal UNDER THE MODEL ALREADY HELD; the bound
gap is unobservable without the posterior that was intractable to begin with.
Not that the FEP is established, general, or settled — genuinely contested. See NA-02 § Honest bounds: Bruineberg et
al. (2022) BBS 45:e183 · Aguilera et al. (2022) Phys. Life Rev. 40:24–50 · Colombo & Wright (2021) Synthese
Not that γ has a universal natural value — NOT-MEASURED [NA02-05].
Not that UNI computes G or schedules from it. G(π) is framing vocabulary; UNI-side disposition NEGATIVE / drift, and
UNI’s ledger — not this plate — is the authority on UNI build status.
Not a UNI gate. A nature citation is never a UNI gate: reading Friston or Da Costa raises no rung and makes no UNI
Nothing about “full human” or “beyond human” — permanent open questions, never a target, never a deliverable.
